MO-16-3 extends Shiraishi's gastrostomy series through March 2023, with 38 neurologic cases among 201 total. Oral intake alongside gastrostomy was 56% in pooled neurologic cases and 40% or less in Parkinson and PSP. No foods, separate raw counts or food-specific outcome.

MO-17-5 describes a Parkinson patient with previous gastrectomy and aspiration pneumonia during nasogastric feeding. An unspecified blended diet resumed on day 49 after aspiration-prevention surgery, and oral feeding later met his nutritional needs. No specific ingredient or isolated texture effect.
